requested_baseline_policy: Reuse existing completed official V4 one-shot baseline; do not rerun it.
preregistered_baseline_policy: Run a fresh baseline arm from the immutable Step 9.32 snapshot; do not reuse the prior official one-shot result as the only baseline arm.
blocking_conflicts: Requested reuse-only baseline conflicts with frozen Step 9.32 fresh-baseline requirement.
Preregistered randomized case/arm order cannot be applied retroactively to the completed fixed-order baseline.
The frozen Step 9.29a runner rejects the treatment Agent identity; no common paired runner was used for both arms.
The already adjudicated baseline cannot be retroactively blinded/randomized with a future treatment arm under the preregistered reviewer procedure.

comparison_policy_preserved_from_preregi.critical_pairing: case-level baseline/treatment binary status and discordance
